title: Cheap item, *expensive* stop
subtitle: Buy by impact and risk, not spend alone. Illustrative examples.

stages.name: List your top 30 items
stages.desc: Raw and packing materials, services, spares

stages.name: Score impact and supply risk
stages.desc: Impact: moves cost or sales. Risk: few suppliers, no substitute.

stages.name: Buy by quadrant
stages.desc: Preforms: partner. Sugar: tender hard. Cleaning: automate.

stages.name: Fix bottlenecks first
stages.desc: Low spend, high risk, e.g. a single-source label: buffer it, add a 2nd source

takeaway: Spend shows what costs most. Risk shows what can stop the line.

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
